segments.translation_html:
I gladly rejoice in virtue,
Which gives all sentient beings rest
From the suffering of the lower realms
And places those who suffer in happiness.

segments.translation_text: When sentient beings who dwell in samsara, particularly those in the three lower realms who are exhausted and weary of suffering, find a little temporary relief in a higher birth, the cause of attaining that happiness is the performance of worldly virtue. The cause of the happiness of those suffering beings is contaminated virtue, and as a result they take higher rebirth in the realm of humans and gods. With happiness and delight, rejoice for them without jealousy.

segments.translation_html:

Which becomes the cause of enlightenment;

Completely free of the suffering of samsara.

segments.translation_text: I rejoice in the accumulation of the two heaps of merit which are the cause of attaining the three types of enlightenment that are the ultimate liberation. I also rejoice in sentient beings’ accumulation of merit that completely frees them from the suffering of samsara and establishes them in nirvana, the state beyond suffering.

segments.translation_text: Imagine offering golden wheels as a token of request to all the fully enlightened Bhagwan Buddhas of the ten directions and three times. Physically perform gestures of respect. Verbally request the Buddhas to light the bright lamp of the holy Dharma which dispels the darkness of ignorance and shows the right path. Thus request the Buddhas to teach the Dharma according to the individual capacities of those suffering beings who are confused by the darkness of ignorance, and do not know the right from the wrong path.

segments.translation_text: A Buddha’s dharmakaya does not enter nirvana, however once the rupakaya has accomplished its holy activities, it temporarily demonstrates passing into nirvana. Addressing holy beings with such an intention, physically fold your hands and verbally request them, "For the benefit of sentient beings, so that their wisdom eyes will not remain obscured by the cataract of ignorance, and in order that they come to see clearly what is to be discarded and what is to be adopted, I supplicate you to remain for countless eons without entering nirvana.”

segments.translation_text: Having created enlightenment thought, in order to perform the benefit of sentient beings, I wish to completely give this body of mine that is created out of aggregates and that I greatly cherish. Likewise I give my retinue, possessions, food, all of my other resources, and the virtues that I have accumulated in the past, present, and future. I give these gifts without miserliness or expectation of reward or result for the purpose of accomplishing the welfare of every sentient being without exception, so that they may achieve higher rebirth and ultimate liberation.

segments.translation_text: By the accumulation of merit arising from completely giving my body and all of my possessions, my mind will attain the great bliss of non-abiding nirvana. All contaminated physical objects must be abandoned at the time of death, and will eventually disintegrate. Therefore, giving everything at this time to sentient beings in order to satisfy their various needs becomes a method of accomplishing the greatest benefit for myself and others.

segments.translation_text: Also, may I support the life of beings, as do the elements of earth which is the foundation of all other elements; water which combines things together; fire which helps things to mature; air which prevents decay and causes medicines, berries, and crops to flourish and is the necessary cause of living beings’ survival; and space which provides conditions, allows movement, and establishes location. In a multitude of ways, may it be the cause of survival for every living being.

segments.translation_text: From now onward, no matter what befalls me, I will perform only actions that are suitable to the Mahayana race. I will endeavor to never pollute myself by the stains of faults and downfalls.

segments.translation_html:
Like a blind person finding a precious jewel
On a heap of rubbish.
Likewise, by some coincidence,
This enlightenment thought was born within me.

segments.translation_text: A blind person searching in a heap of garbage who finds a precious jewel would be amazed. This is a great and delightful miracle.

segments.translation_html:
For sentient beings traveling on the path of existence,
Who wish to experience happiness,
It is the excellent cause of happiness
Which provides a banquet for sentient beings.

segments.wylie: gro ba rigs drug mtha' yas pa'i 'gron po srid pa 'khor ba'i lam bgrod dka' ba rnams su yang dang yang du rgyu zhinga sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis dub par gyur pa las/ mthar bde ba chen po'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa thob cing spyad par 'dod pa rnams la byang chub kyi sems 'di ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba'i mchog ma lus pa sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu nyid du nye bar gnas taེ/ de bas na sems can gyi 'gron po chen po rnams bde ba'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pas tshim par byed pa yina pas dga' bar gyis shig ces pa'o/ /
segments.translation_text: The limitless beings in the six realms of existence are like guests who travel a difficult and exhausting journey along the path of samsara that is filled with many sufferings. Those among them who wish to reach the destination of inexhaustible great happiness should develop enlightenment thought. It is the cause of accomplishing every type of temporary and ultimate happiness without exception. Through it, sentient beings, the great guests, will be satisfied by all types of excellent happiness and joy.

segments.translation_html:
Today. I invite all beings as guests to Sugatahood.
And to happiness until then.
With all the Protectors as witnesses,
All the gods and demi-gods rejoice.

segments.translation_text: From now onward, I who have developed this great enlightenment thought, in the presence of the Protectors, the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, as my witnesses, invite these limitless beings as guests to the ultimate great bliss of the Sugatas, and until they attain that, to the temporary success of happiness and higher rebirth. I promise to provide happiness and benefit to all sentient beings, so the minds of the gods, humans, and demigods should be clear and filled with happiness and joy.
